statements.quote: Despite sustained macroeconomic headwinds and others pulling back on EV investments, we remain focused on expanding our vehicle and energy product lineup, reducing costs and making critical investments in AI projects and production capacity.
statements.notes: Present-tense ongoing investment with no year named. 'Investments in AI projects' is not specified as capex versus opex, so capex is assumed. Treated as actual for the reported year, but it could also be read as forward-looking.
